description: Reusable brand color palette for the website, invoices, proposals, and other branded documents.

ink.usage: Primary text, headings, logos, and dark panels

terracotta.usage: Primary accent, buttons, highlights, and invoice totals

rust.usage: Strong accent for emphasis and active states

sage.usage: Secondary accent for labels, links, and supporting details

sand.usage: Borders, dividers, rules, and table lines

softPeach.usage: Soft highlight fills and subtle decorative accents

paper.usage: Light text, cards, and secondary paper surfaces

mutedInk.usage: Secondary text, notes, metadata, and invoice footnotes
